location_qualifier: Guadalcanal; two battalions present by mid-October
current_activity: first battalions already on the island
notes: Miller, chapter VI: by mid-October 1942 two battalions of the 38th Division were on Guadalcanal with the 2nd Division. This is not a claim that the division headquarters or Lt. Gen. Sano had yet landed (the main body was still to come by transport; Miller, ch. VII). Confidence 0.5.
